```lean
theorem lg_target (a b : ℕ) (h : a * b = 12) (ha : a > b) (hb : b > 2) : a = 4 := by
  have h_b_ge_3 : b ≥ 3 := hb
  have h_b_le_3 : b ≤ 3 := by rw [Nat.le_iff_lt_or_eq]; exact Or.inl (le_of_gt hb)
  have h_b_eq_3 : b = 3 := Nat.eq_of_le_eq h_b_ge_3 h_b_le_3
  rw [h_b_eq_3] at h
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_left h (Nat.succ_pos 3)
```
